steps.say: The model uses a particular attention called Scaled Dot-Product Attention. Equation shows the combination. Queries, keys and values are packed into matrices Q, K and V for a sentence.

For n words, think of Q as n by dk and K as n by dk, so its transpose is dk by n. Their product gives n by n scores, one weight per word pair. Multiplying by V, which is n by dv, gives n by dv output. The left side shows scaled dot-product attention.
